subject.title: Add typed Project Record composed block

question: Should this draft PR be closed as already represented on current main, or retained as the explicit reviewed vehicle for the Project Record contract?
rationale: The repository policy prohibits automated closure, and only the approval-gate owner can confirm the intended relationship between the draft branch and the implementation already present on main.

options.title: Reconcile as already on main
options.body: Confirm that current main intentionally contains the reviewed implementation and close the draft PR manually.

options.title: Retain the PR for an explicit merge gate
options.body: Keep the draft PR open if it remains the required human-reviewed record before the contract is considered merged.

recommendation.title: Reconcile as already on main
recommendation.body: Confirm that current main intentionally contains the reviewed implementation and close the draft PR manually.
